entities.name: Alfred Michael Watson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Michael Watson was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the seventh bishop of the Diocese of Erie in Pennsylvania (1969–1982). He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of Erie from 1965 to 1969.
